main_text.p: An filio adversus Patrem perduellem, hostem Patriæ, injustum ac violentum aggressorem? Resp. Aut quæritur quid quispiam affectus intuitu malit, an pati ut ipse occidatur à Patre, an potius suum Patrem occidere? Aut quid de rigore juris sit permissum, & de jure civili sit comprobatum? Si prius, potius malim quævis sufferre patienter, quam vitam Patri adimere, utpote à quo vitam & omnia post Deum, accepi. Arg. l. 13. §. 4. D. Remilit. l. 9. D. de obseq. Parent. & Patr. Præstand. l. 1. §. 28. D. Ad Silanian.

Si posterius quæratur? Respondeo ante omnia exorandi & placandi remedia esse adhibenda. Quibus si non auscultet pater, de jure in Patriam amor amori parentis erit præferendus. l. 3. §. fin. D. Ad l. Cor-

page.notes: The line "nel." at the lower right is the catchword, not running text, so it is placed in the catchword element. The text ends at "Cor-" as printed. The section numbers VI. and VII. are bare numbers and are therefore written as paragraphs, not headings. The citations are part of the column and are in italics within the paragraph.
